Bill.BriefDescription: Phasing in audible pedestrian crossing signals.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to audible pedestrian crossing signals; and addinga new section to chapter 47.36 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.36 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall ensure that audible pedestrian crossingsignals be installed along any state highway that is beingreconstructed and where the project meets the following conditions: (1) The project scope includes the addition of pedestrian crossingsignals; (2) The project borders two or more general purpose localjurisdictions; and (3) The inclusion of audible signals is consistent with localzoning and land use patterns and each local jurisdiction bordering theproject requests the installation of the devices. The department may work with local jurisdictions to identify otherappropriate technologies as necessary to carry out the intent of thissection. The department must ensure that, to the extent possible, allcrossings at that location are uniformly equipped. Signals must p. 1 SHB 2590conform to the guidelines approved by the American Association of StateHighway Officials and as set out in the Manual on Uniform TrafficControl Devices.
